answer_text: No. The sanitary-recommendations regime (périmètres de prescription et de recommandation sanitaires) appears only in the general rules of zone UH (PDF p.101, printed 100) (c-01)[Dans les périmètres de prescription et de recommandation sanitaires, il est recommandé que les travaux soient effectués sous le contrôle d'un organisme d'expertise agréé] and zone UX (PDF p.169, printed 168) (c-02)[Dans les périmètres de prescription et de recommandation sanitaires, il est recommandé que les travaux soient effectués sous le contrôle d'un organisme]. The zone UMG section, which begins with (c-04)[La zone UMG correspond au quartier Joliot-Curie], contains no such provision in the pages read. The UMG pages read (PDF 320–322) contain only a general reference to the sanitary annexes (c-05)[Les caractéristiques des installations et des réseaux d'assainissement doivent être conformes aux normes édictées dans le règlement d'assainissement communautaire (Cf. Annexes sanitaires)]. A whole-document search for 'recommandations sanitaires' returned only PDF pp.101 and 169 (c-03)[DANS LE PERIMETRE DE RECOMMANDATIONS : Les dispositions imposées dans le périmètre de prescriptions sont simplement recommandées] and no hit in the UMG section.
additional_context: The regime exists in the corpus but is attached to the UH and UX zone sections, not UMG. The whole-document search was broader than the likely_source_documents scope (general provisions and annexes); this expansion is flagged per rule 1. The UMG pages were checked by search plus a read of PDF 320–322 only, not a page-by-page read of PDF 323–333. The printed page numbers are one less than the PDF page numbers throughout (e.g. PDF 320 = printed 319). The planner's rationale did not assert that the regime applies to UMG, so no claim was contradicted. This text answer does not resolve the graphic overlap: the dashed purple recommandations perimeter on the map remains undetermined, and the zone-section text does not show whether the map perimeter applies to UMG.
